items.title: 14.4.5 Coplanar Vectors and Condition for Coplanarity of Three Vectors (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Ab hum 14.4 ke sab se kaam ke sawal par aa gaye: kya teen vectors (ya chaar points) ek hi plane mein hain? Is ka jawab dena bohat aasan ho jata hai agar aap pichli baat yaad rakhein: scalar triple product dabbe ka volume hai. Agar dabba bilkul chapta (flat) ho, to volume zero. Bas yahi poora sabaq hai; ab ise tafseel se samajhte hain.
Kitab ki definition: vectors coplanar kehlate hain agar woh ek hi plane mein hon, ya unhein ek hi plane mein laaya ja sake.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: "Ek plane mein laaya ja sake" ka matlab: vector ko apne aap ke parallel khiskane (move karne) se woh badalta nahin. To agar teeno vectors ko ek hi point se shuru karne ke liye khiska dein aur woh teeno ek hi sateh mein aa jayen, to woh coplanar hain. Jaise mez par rakhi teen pensilen: un ko kahin bhi khiskao, mez ki sateh par hi rahengi.
Ab maan lijiye teen coplanar vectors \(\underline{u}\), \(\underline{v}\) aur \(\underline{w}\) ek plane mein hain, jaisa figure mein dikhaya gaya hai.

blocks.alt: A grey plane with three vectors u, v and w drawn in it from one point. The vector v x w rises from that point perpendicular to the plane, with right-angle marks at its foot. As in the print, each letter carries a small arrow over it.
blocks.caption: Figure: coplanar vectors u, v, w; v × w is perpendicular to the plane (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.text: Cross product \(\underline{v}\times \underline{w}\) ek aisa vector deta hai jo \(\underline{v}\) aur \(\underline{w}\) dono par perpendicular hai. Kyun ke \(\underline{u}\), \(\underline{v}\), \(\underline{w}\) ek hi plane mein hain, is liye \(\underline{v}\times \underline{w}\) \(\underline{u}\) par bhi perpendicular hai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text: Isay yun samjhiye: \(\underline{v}\times \underline{w}\) poori plane par seedha khara hai, jaise farsh par khara jhanda (flagpole). \(\underline{u}\) usi farsh par khinchi hui ek lakeer hai. Farsh par seedha khara danda farsh ki har lakeer ke saath 90 degree banata hai. Is liye \(\underline{v}\times \underline{w}\) aur \(\underline{u}\) perpendicular hain.

Is liye \(\underline{u}\) aur \(\underline{v}\times \underline{w}\) ka dot product zero hai:
\[\underline{u}\cdot(\underline{v}\times \underline{w}) = 0\]
\(\because\) agar vectors \(\underline{a}\) aur \(\underline{b}\) perpendicular hon to \(\underline{a}\cdot \underline{b} = 0\) (kyun ke \(\cos 90^{\circ} = 0\)).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is line mein "perpndicular" chhapti hai (ek "e" ghaib). Sahi spelling "perpendicular" hai.

Nateeja: agar teen vectors \(\underline{u}\), \(\underline{v}\) aur \(\underline{w}\) coplanar hon to un ka scalar triple product zero hota hai. 14.4.2 ki zubaan mein: jis dabbe ke teeno kinare ek hi sateh mein hon woh pichak kar chapti sheet ban jata hai, aur us ka volume zero.

items: Agar \(\underline{u}\), \(\underline{v}\) aur \(\underline{w}\) coplanar hon to un se bane parallelepiped ka volume zero hai, yani \((\underline{u}\times \underline{v})\cdot \underline{w} = 0\); aur is ke baraks bhi: vectors \(\underline{u}\), \(\underline{v}\), \(\underline{w}\) coplanar hain \(\Leftrightarrow (\underline{u}\times \underline{v})\cdot \underline{w} = 0\).

Agar scalar triple product ke koi do vectors barabar hon to us ki value zero hai, yani \([\underline{u}\ \underline{u}\ \underline{w}] = [\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{v}] = [\underline{u}\ \underline{w}\ \underline{w}] = 0\).

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Property 1 mein \(\Leftrightarrow\) ka nishaan hai, yani baat dono taraf chalti hai: coplanar hon to zero, aur zero aaye to coplanar. Is liye coplanarity check karne ka tareeqa bilkul seedha hai: \([\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}]\) nikalo; zero aaye to coplanar, warna nahin.
Chaar points \(A, B, C, D\) ke liye: ek kone \(A\) se teen edges banao, \(\underline{AB}\), \(\underline{AC}\), \(\underline{AD}\). Agar \([\underline{AB}\ \underline{AC}\ \underline{AD}] = 0\) ho to chaaron points ek plane mein hain (Example 27). Kyun? Teeno edges \(A\) se guzarti hain; agar woh ek plane mein hain to un ke doosre siron \(B, C, D\) bhi usi plane mein hain.
Property 2 kyun sahi hai? Do vectors barabar hon to determinant ki do rows ek jaisi ho jati hain, aur aise determinant ki value zero hoti hai. Geometry mein bhi: do barabar vectors aur ek teesra hamesha ek hi plane mein aa jate hain, to dabba banta hi nahin.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Ek aasan misaal (yeh hamara sawal hai): \(\underline{u} = \underline{i} + 2\underline{j}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = \underline{i} + 3\underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\). Ghaur karein: \(\underline{w} = \underline{u} + \underline{v}\). Do vectors ka jama unhi ki plane mein hota hai (parallelogram ka diagonal), is liye yeh teeno coplanar hone chahiyen. Check:
\[\begin{vmatrix} 1 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 1 & 3 \\ 1 & 3 & 3 \end{vmatrix}\]
\[= 1(3 - 9) - 2(0 - 3) + 0\]
\[= -6 + 6 = 0\]
Zero aaya, yani coplanar. Andaza aur hisaab dono ek hi baat keh rahe hain.

Ab kitab ki do misaalen: pehli mein chaar points ka test, doosri mein ek unknown \(\alpha\) dhoondna. Dono mein auzaar ek hi hai, determinant; farq sirf itna hai ke pehli mein humein dikhana hai ke jawab zero hai, aur doosri mein jawab ko zaroorat ke mutabiq zero banana hai. Har misaal ke Method wale hisse ko ghaur se parhiye, kyun ke wahi asal soch hai; hisaab to us ke baad aata hai.

blocks.title: Example 27
blocks.problem: Prove that four points \(A(-3, 5, -4)\), \(B(-1, 1, 1)\), \(C(-1, 2, 2)\) and \(D(-3, 4, -5)\) are coplanar.
steps:
Given: \(A(-3, 5, -4)\), \(B(-1, 1, 1)\), \(C(-1, 2, 2)\), \(D(-3, 4, -5)\).
To prove: chaaron points ek hi plane mein hain.
Method: points tab coplanar hain jab \(A\) se nikalne wali teen edges \(\underline{AB}\), \(\underline{AC}\), \(\underline{AD}\) coplanar hon, yani un par bane dabbe ka volume \([\underline{AB}\ \underline{AC}\ \underline{AD}] = 0\) ho (Property 1). Plan: teen edges, phir determinant, phir dekhna ke zero aata hai ya nahin.

Step 1: Edge \(\underline{AB}\)
\[\underline{AB} = \underline{OB} - \underline{OA}\]
\[= (-1+3)\underline{i} + (1-5)\underline{j} + (1+4)\underline{k}\]
\[= 2\underline{i} - 4\underline{j} + 5\underline{k}\]
Kyun: aakhri point minus shuru wala point. Dhyan dein: \(-3\) ko minus karna yani \(3\) jama karna, isi liye \(+3\) likha hai. Negative coordinates mein sab se zyada ghaltiyan yahin hoti hain.

Step 2: Edge \(\underline{AC}\)
\[\underline{AC} = \underline{OC} - \underline{OA}\]
\[= (-1+3)\underline{i} + (2-5)\underline{j} + (2+4)\underline{k}\]
\[= 2\underline{i} - 3\underline{j} + 6\underline{k}\]
Kyun: wahi rule, \(C\) minus \(A\).

Step 3: Edge \(\underline{AD}\)
\[\underline{AD} = \underline{OD} - \underline{OA}\]
\[= (-3+3)\underline{i} + (4-5)\underline{j} + (-5+4)\underline{k}\]
\[= 0\underline{i} - \underline{j} - \underline{k}\]
Kyun: wahi rule; \(\underline{i}\) wala hissa zero aaya, use bhi determinant mein 0 likhenge.

Step 4: Scalar triple product ka determinant
\[[\underline{AB}\ \underline{AC}\ \underline{AD}] = \begin{vmatrix} 2 & -4 & 5 \\ 2 & -3 & 6 \\ 0 & -1 & -1 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: rows teeno edges ke components hain, signs samet.

Step 6: Nateeja
\(\underline{AB}\), \(\underline{AC}\), \(\underline{AD}\) se bane parallelepiped ka volume zero hai, is liye yeh teen vectors coplanar hain. Teeno \(A\) se guzarte hain, is liye \(A\), \(B\), \(C\), \(D\) ek hi plane mein hain.
Kyun: zero volume wala dabba chapta hota hai; us ke saare kinare ek sateh mein hote hain.
blocks.answer: \([\underline{AB}\ \underline{AC}\ \underline{AD}] = 0\), is liye points \(A\), \(B\), \(C\) aur \(D\) coplanar hain. Saabit ho gaya.

blocks.title: Example 28
blocks.problem: Find the value of \(\alpha\), so that \(\alpha\underline{i} + \underline{j}\), \(\underline{i} + \underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\) and \(2\underline{i} + \underline{j} - 2\underline{k}\) are coplanar.
steps:
Given: \(\underline{u} = \alpha\underline{i} + \underline{j} + 0\underline{k}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{i} + \underline{j} + 3\underline{k}\), \(\underline{w} = 2\underline{i} + \underline{j} - 2\underline{k}\).
To find: \(\alpha\) ki woh value jis par teeno vectors coplanar hon.
Method: coplanar \(\Leftrightarrow [\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}] = 0\). Yahan ek unknown \(\alpha\) hai, to triple product \(\alpha\) ki shakal mein aayega; use zero ke barabar rakh kar ek saada equation hal karenge.

Step 1: Determinant banayein
\[[\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}] = \begin{vmatrix} \alpha & 1 & 0 \\ 1 & 1 & 3 \\ 2 & 1 & -2 \end{vmatrix}\]
Kyun: \(\underline{u}\) mein \(\underline{k}\) wala hissa nahin, is liye teesra component 0 likha. Unknown \(\alpha\) bhi aam number ki tarah row mein jata hai.

Step 2: Pehli row par expand karein
\[= \alpha(-2 - 3) - 1(-2 - 6) + 0(1 - 2)\]
\[= -5\alpha + 8\]
Kyun: pehla term \(\alpha\big[(1)(-2) - (3)(1)\big] = \alpha(-5)\); doosra (minus wala) \(-1\big[(1)(-2) - (3)(2)\big] = -1(-8) = 8\); teesra 0 se zarb hai, is liye khatam.

Step 3: Coplanarity ki shart lagayein
\[-5\alpha + 8 = 0\]
\[\alpha = \dfrac{8}{5}\]
Kyun: vectors tabhi coplanar hain jab triple product zero ho. \(8\) ko doosri taraf le gaye: \(-5\alpha = -8\), phir \(-5\) se divide: \(\alpha = \frac{8}{5}\).

Tasdeeq: \(\alpha = \frac{8}{5}\) rakhein. \(\underline{v}\times \underline{w} = -5\underline{i} + 8\underline{j} - \underline{k}\); \(\underline{u}\cdot(\underline{v}\times \underline{w}) = \frac{8}{5}(-5) + 1(8) + 0(-1) = -8 + 8 = 0\). Zero aaya, yani coplanar.

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Agar Example 28 mein \(\alpha = 0\) hota to kya teeno vectors coplanar hote?
Jawab: nahin. \(\alpha = 0\) par \(-5\alpha + 8 = 8 \ne 0\), yani dabbe ka volume 8 hai, dabba chapta nahin. Sirf ek hi value \(\alpha = \frac{8}{5}\) teeno ko ek plane mein laati hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Coplanar vectors ek plane mein hote hain (ya apne parallel khiska kar ek plane mein laaye ja sakte hain).
2. \(\underline{u}, \underline{v}, \underline{w}\) coplanar \(\Leftrightarrow [\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}] = 0\).
3. Chaar points \(A, B, C, D\) coplanar \(\Leftrightarrow [\underline{AB}\ \underline{AC}\ \underline{AD}] = 0\).
4. Do vectors barabar hon to triple product zero.
5. Unknown wale sawal: determinant ko zero ke barabar rakho aur equation hal karo.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. Points ke coordinates hi determinant mein rakh dena. Pehle edges \(\underline{AB}, \underline{AC}, \underline{AD}\) banayein.
2. Edges mukhtalif points se le lena, jaise \(\underline{AB}, \underline{BC}, \underline{CD}\) bina soche. Teeno ek hi point se shuru honi chahiyen.
3. Negative coordinates mein sign ki ghalti: \(-1 - (-3) = -1 + 3 = 2\), \(-4\) nahin.
4. Determinant zero na aaye to bhi "coplanar" likh dena. Zero nahin to coplanar nahin; jawab wahi likhiye jo hisaab kehta hai.
